SELECT SEQ_USER_PHONE_CHANGE_LOG.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO USER_PHONE_CHANGE_LOG ( ID, THIRD_USER_ID, USER_TYPE, OLD_MSISDN, NEW_MSISDN, OPER_TYPE, OPER_TIME, OPERATOR, REMARK, CREATE_TMS, SIGN_SYNC_STATUS, SIGN_SYNC_RETRY_COUNT ) VALUES ( #{id,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{thirdUserId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{oldMsisdn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{newMsisdn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{operType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{operTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{operator,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{createTms,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{signSyncStatus,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE USER_PHONE_CHANGE_LOG SET SIGN_SYNC_STATUS = 'FAILED', SIGN_SYNC_RETRY_COUNT = NVL(SIGN_SYNC_RETRY_COUNT, 0) + 1, SIGN_SYNC_TIME = #{syncTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, SIGN_SYNC_RESULT = #{syncResult,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE ID = #{id,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND SIGN_SYNC_STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')

UPDATE USER_PHONE_CHANGE_LOG SET SIGN_SYNC_STATUS = 'FAILED', SIGN_SYNC_RETRY_COUNT = #{terminalRetryCount,jdbcType=NUMERIC}, SIGN_SYNC_TIME = #{syncTime,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, SIGN_SYNC_RESULT = #{syncResult,jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE ID = #{id,jdbcType=NUMERIC} AND SIGN_SYNC_STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED')
mapper.select: SELECT ID, THIRD_USER_ID, NEW_MSISDN, SIGN_SYNC_STATUS, SIGN_SYNC_RETRY_COUNT FROM ( SELECT ID, THIRD_USER_ID, NEW_MSISDN, SIGN_SYNC_STATUS, NVL(SIGN_SYNC_RETRY_COUNT, 0) AS SIGN_SYNC_RETRY_COUNT FROM USER_PHONE_CHANGE_LOG WHERE SIGN_SYNC_STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'FAILED') AND NVL(SIGN_SYNC_RETRY_COUNT, 0) < #{maxRetry,jdbcType=NUMERIC} ORDER BY ID ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit,jdbcType=NUMERIC}
